description: This file defines a controller class SaveTerminationReasonController responsible for managing the pre-render logic for termination reason views in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It sets up Vue components based on request attributes to either edit or save termination reasons.

classes.name: SaveTerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller managing pre-render logic for termination reason Vue components, initializing different components based on presence of 'id' attribute.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for the page, choosing between editing or saving a termination reason based on request parameters.
